name: hangman
description: Hangman game service. To start / hint / quit a game, publish on `game.hangman.command` with content either a JSON `{action, theme?}` (preferred) or a loose string. Recognised commands: `start` (optional theme = anything, e.g. 'cuisine', 'animals', 'star wars'), `hint`, `quit`, `status`. Examples — content=`{"action":"start","theme":"cuisine"}` or content=`start cuisine`. Letter / full-word guesses arrive on `chat.input` automatically during an active game (single letter, or word of matching length); the brain doesn't need to forward those. The game narrates every event on `chat.response` so every connected chat surface stays in sync.

default_subscriptions.description: During an active game, single letters become letter guesses and full words matching the answer length become full-word guesses. Outside a game, plain text is ignored — the brain decides when to start a game and uses game.hangman.command instead.

Hangman game control plane. Publish a JSON `{action, theme?}` payload to drive the game. Use `{"action":"start"}` to start a fresh game (optionally `{"action":"start","theme":"cuisine"}` for a themed word), `{"action":"hint"}` for a clue, `{"action":"quit"}` to abandon, `{"action":"status"}` to publish the current game state. This is how the brain (or the UI) starts / hints / ends games on the player's behalf when the player asks in natural language on chat.input.
